title: 5 checks before a long road trip
hook: Do these 5 checks before your next road trip
youtube_title: What to check before a long road trip in India

slides.heading: Do these 5 checks before your next road trip

voice_lines: First, tyres. Check the pressure cold, as per the door sticker, the spare too, and look for cuts or bulges.
Next, fluids with the engine cold: engine oil between min and max, coolant at the mark, and washer fluid full.
Then make sure the wipers clear the glass, and every light and indicator works.
Last, the brakes should feel firm, with no squeal and no pull. Safe trip! Any doubts? Comment below or DM me on Instagram.
caption:
Wedding season road trips are here 🚗 Five quick checks before you leave, all doable in your parking:

1. Tyre pressure (cold), as per the door sticker
2. Spare tyre pressure, and no cuts or bulges
3. Engine oil, coolant and washer fluid, with the engine cold
4. Wipers and all lights
5. Brakes: firm pedal, no squeal, no pull

Save this and run through it before your next trip.

Any doubts? Comment below or DM me on Instagram 👇
